WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.frequency,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.frequency
),
above_mean AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM account_averages
    WHERE avg_signed_amount > (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) FROM account_averages)
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS average_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS average_balance,
    AVG(avg_signed_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) FROM account_averages)) AS average_excess
FROM above_mean;
